dedupe_keys.name: baseline building energy performance simulation models for four european clusters

description: This dataset holds four baseline building energy performance simulation models, one for each of four clusters of European countries, in spreadsheet form. It was published by Ulrich Filippi Oberegger of Eurac Research on 21 December 2023 to accompany the paper 'Bottom-up method to derive cost curves for heat savings in buildings for all European countries'. The models are derived from the demonstration spreadsheet of the EPB Center for the ISO 52016-1 standard, which calculates hourly energy needs for heating and cooling, and represent typical buildings whose savings from renovation measures feed the cost curves. Coverage is Europe, grouped into four climate and building-stock clusters; each model is an Excel workbook of about 14 MB. Access: open download from Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: spreadsheet models of representative buildings, so results are indicative for a cluster, not any real building; the cluster definitions are given in the paper. Simulation uses are renovation scenario and heat-saving cost-curve analysis, and teaching or checking ISO 52016-1 calculations. Related records: the crossCert EPC benchmark buildings and archetypal.
